gaps_closed_after_bump.length_diff_for_subperm: Ruliad/ListDiff.lean — `l.Subperm g → (g.diff l).length = g.length - l.length`. Absent from Mathlib and Batteries at v4.35.0. Must be stated over [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α], not [DecidableEq α]: that is the typeclass List.diff actually takes, and a DecidableEq-stated version builds a different BEq instance so `rw` silently fails to match.
gaps_closed_after_bump.exact_edge_count: Ruliad/Hypergraph.lean `length_fire` — |fire| = |g| - |lhs| + |rhs| on a genuine match, plus `length_fire_eq_of_balanced`. Previously only a bound.
gaps_closed_after_bump.rulial_metric: Ruliad/Rulial.lean `rulialDistFinset_triangle` + `rulialDistFinset_isMetric` — rulial distance is a genuine metric on rule SETS, via symmDiff_triangle and Finset.card_union_le. The multiset (List) triangle inequality remains open.
gaps_closed_after_bump.hindley_rosen_terminating: Ruliad/Bridge.lean `confluent_union_of_terminating`. Classical non-terminating form still open.
gaps_closed_after_bump.event_level_causal_graph: Ruliad/CausalGraph.lean — tokenized hyperedges, so an event names exactly what it consumed and produced. `causal_forward` proves no event consumes a token produced by a later event: the causal graph is a DAG oriented with the update order. Also `causal_irrefl`, `produced_not_mem`, `mkTokens_nodup`, `applyEvent_wf`, `Run.split`.

differential_oracle.purpose: Raise journal claim V13 (Lean models mirror deployed source) from Admiralty C3 toward B2 by measurement rather than assertion.
differential_oracle.design: One shared corpus (diff/corpus.tsv) read by both sides. Lean side: lean_exe ruliaddiff over Ruliad.Multiway.explore. Gleam side: Erlang harness calling the DEPLOYED 'cepaf_gleam@ecology@multiway':explore/3 on the BEAM from existing build output - no reimplementation. Classifier: OCaml (compare.ml), exits 1 on divergence. Three languages chosen by where each subject lives; no shell/Python/Node logic.

divergence_classes.class: input bounds: UTF-8 bytes vs characters
divergence_classes.finding: multiway.gleam guards on string.byte_size; the model used character length. On a 70-character/140-byte seed the model returned OK where the deployed engine refuses with its bounds error.
divergence_classes.status: FIXED - Multiway.byteSize + BoundsOk; both cases agree on re-run

divergence_classes.finding: Gleam's occurrences prepends (descending offsets); the model's filterMap over List.range is ascending. Edge and state SETS agree.
divergence_classes.status: ACCEPTED - no theorem depends on order; recorded in the module header

divergence_classes.finding: Gleam walks with pop_grapheme (grapheme indices); the model indexes List Char (Unicode scalars). On e+U+0301 they read 1 vs 2. Precomposed characters and astral-plane emoji agree, since there one grapheme is one scalar. This class was NOT covered by the module's previous header note.
divergence_classes.status: NOT FIXED, RECORDED - matching would require Unicode grapheme-cluster segmentation in Lean

differential_oracle.root_cause: multiway.gleam measures its input guard in UTF-8 bytes and scans for matches in graphemes; those coincide only on ASCII. The model had used a third notion (Unicode scalars) for both roles, producing two independent divergence classes.

forecast_resolved.statement: Differential testing will find >= 1 disagreement, from the byte-vs-grapheme length boundary.
forecast_resolved.qualification: Right about existence; partly right about cause. The forecast named one mechanism and there were two - the Edge.offset grapheme/scalar class was not anticipated. p=0.60 was under-confident given the header already admitted a known mismatch.

differential_oracle.scope_limits: Raises V13 to B2 for Ruliad.Multiway ONLY, and only on this 23-case corpus. Hypergraph, Branchial, Service and the Mojo kernel have no oracle and remain C3. No property-based generation. The oracle is not wired into any gate, though compare exits 1 on divergence.

unicode_oracle.finding: All 5,029 Unicode divergences are the ALREADY DOCUMENTED offset-coordinate class (grapheme index vs Unicode scalar index). unicode_oracle.classifier_change: compare.ml gained an OFFSET_ONLY class that strips an edge's :offset suffix while RETAINING @rule, so a disagreement about which rule fired is still content, not coordinates. ecology_capability_ffi:run_bounded_cd hard-caps a bounded command at TimeoutMs =< 60000. A 180s budget was rejected as invalid_resource_bound. The FFI cap was LEFT ALONE - widening a safety bound to fit a new tool is the wrong direction. The binding now uses 55s plus --no-build.
--no-build refuses with PREREQUISITES_ABSENT and exit 1 when the Lean executables are missing, so an absent prerequisite is a failure and never a silent pass.
runtime_integration.receipt_cache: var/ruliad-oracle/latest.json, mirroring tools/preflight --max-age. A receipt is honoured only if the checker+classifier+generator digest matches AND the cached generated_cases >= the requested --cases, so a --cases 100000 request cannot be satisfied by a stored --cases 10 run. Both directions verified.

Topic outside indrajaal/mcp/request/** -> refused, no reply.
Caller-chosen reply_topic -> FOREIGN_REPLY_DESTINATION_FORBIDDEN. The reply destination is pinned from the request key, so a signed envelope cannot redirect its own answer.

confluence_repair.root_cause: vacuity is not a type error. A proof assistant checks that a proof establishes its statement, never that the statement is worth establishing. No gate category can detect this; only an explicit non-triviality obligation sited next to the claim converts it into a compile error.
